title: Docker Container Status
description: Check whether a specified Docker container is running.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

CONTAINER="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$CONTAINER" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 container_name_or_id" >&2
    exit 1
fi

STATUS=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$CONTAINER" 2>/dev/null || true)

if [[ "$STATUS" == "running" ]]; then
    echo "OK: Container $CONTAINER is running."
else
    echo "WARNING: Container $CONTAINER status: ${STATUS:-not found}"
    exit 1
fi
